hadith:
Retiring to a Mosque for Remembrance of Allah (I'tikaf) - Narrated `Aisha:

The Prophet (ﷺ) used to embrace me during my menses. He also used to put his head out of the mosque while he was in I`tikaf, and I would wash it during my menses.
message: Praise Allah, the All-Wise and All-Aware, and trust in His vast knowledge and bounty. The Prophet’s example reminds us that menstruation does not prevent kindness and caring acts.
name:
Al Waasi' - الْوَاسِعُ - The All-Encompassing

Al Waasi' expresses the vastness of Allah's knowledge and bounty. The cited passages connect the name with His knowing, giving and favour. All-encompassing here should not be explained as a physical substance occupying or filling space.
verse:
Saba - Sheba - 34:1

All praise is for Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And praise be to Him in the Hereafter. He is the All-Wise, All-Aware.
